name: smwmusic-py-gity
title: Py & Gity 2: The Industrial Age - BOSS.MOD
description:
The short but menacing boss theme from obscure Korean MS-DOS beat 'em up Py & Gity 2 - The Industrial Age, which is also used for the pre-level FMVs depicting each level's boss.

Could fit boss battles, cutscenes, and industrial themed levels. Due to the repetitive nature of the track, it's not recommended to use on longer levels.
